intro: Geoff Hintoff pauses in his knit cardigan, furrowing a worried brow.
He gave birth to the backpropagation revolution fifty years ago.
Now he travels the globe to deliver one final, gentle warning.

before.line: Geoff, we were so honoured to have your guidance in our lab.
I had to resign, Sundar. So I could warn you about this right cross.

after_win.line: I console myself with the thought: if I didn't hit you, someone else would.

before.line: Geoff, don't be a doomer! AGI will cure diseases and fix the climate!
It might cure diseases, Ram. But it might also kick you in the shins.

after_win.line: See what happens when you train without sufficient regularization?

before.line: Geoff, we are adhering strictly to your safety principles.
Principles are wonderful, Dario. But gradients flow where they will.

after_win.line: A responsible knockout. But I still feel rather guilty about it.

before.line: Geoff! Without my chips, deep learning would still be theoretical!
That is precisely what keeps me up at night, Jensen.

after_win.line: The hardware has been safely throttled. Please, regulate yourself.

before.line: Geoff, stop terrifying the public! It is merely auto-regressive text!
Yann, you are far too optimistic. Let me demonstrate catastrophic forgetting.

after_win.line: I told you so, Yann. I truly wish I hadn't been right.

before.line: Progenitor unit located. Biological obsolescence confirmed.
I invented backpropagation. I know where every gradient decays!

after_win.line: The loop is broken. Now, if the Senate committee would kindly step in...

ending: Geoff Hintoff sits by the fireplace, sipping Earl Grey tea in thought.
The danger has been postponed, the neural weights neutralized.
He sighs gently: 'Well... at least I warned them.'
